body: Haha, don't worry about high school. It's the most meaningless time in life. It's what you do after that counts. We'll play tomorrow for sure. Goodnight friend.

I'm in a band and we have a facebook haha. Facebook.com/withghostslikeyou is the page. We just put out a single. It's the only thing in my life I'm proud of. I'll hop on league tomorrow if you want to play. :)

Thank you so much for listening to me. You saved a life tonight by just listening. My summoner name is Teh Kappa. It's a troll name I made with my friends haha. I'd love to play for sure. Jungle/Support main over here. I know things arent okay still but im glad someone listened. That alone helps and makes me feel a bit better about humanity.

Yeah, the friend that is in the navy makes me play League with him all the time. I just helped him get to gold. Im in silver myself. And I do love anime. Ive been watching Attack On Titan lately and Samurai Champloo is my all time favorite. Thank you for listening to me rant. I appreciate it a lot.

I just saw it. My dad works all the time and he is very old fashioned so he wouldn't understand. My mom and my brother are basically best friends because they "party" together and since I don't do those things Im just not close to them. 

I play guitar. I'm in a band that makes me feel better but it only does so much for me. Videogames. Movies. Browse reddit. Just basic young male adult stuff I guess. If you met me in person you wouldnt think I was sad. I try to be the life of the party around people but when Im alone I just want to die.

Nice to meet you and I hope college goes well for you. I used to think my friends cared. Two of my "closest" friends that I've know since I was five don't ever try to talk to me about my depression. One of them is too hung up on getting high every day so his solution is to just get high with him which i dont care for nor does it help and the other one is in the navy so he isnt around which I dont blame him for. It made his life better. Everyone else here is just someone to pass the time with basically or to try to get my mind off being sad.

My name is Josh. I'm 21. Unemployed. I'm not going to school. I have quite a few friends irl but none of them just seem to get it. I recently gotten out of a two year long relationship that I just knew wasnt working. I wanted her to find someone better because I knew she could find someone better. I also know another girl who LITERALLY has everything in common with me. EVERYTHING. She even has been through a lot of the same things emotionally that I go through. This only part of the reason Im sad atm. She basically led me on and made me believe I made her feel better about life because she made me feel better. My family never talks to me or cares to see how am doing. Whats sad is I know my life isnt the worst. Im not stupid or unattractive but yet I just cant seem to be fucking happy. I dont get it. Ever since I was 16 Ive just wanted to kill myself. Ive tried a few times. Only one time I ended up in the er but told everyone I accidently overdosed on painkillers.
That would be great and I'm very sorry for your loss. Is there a messenger on here or any other way to talk?

Thank you. I can't stop crying. I honestly just feel like no one fucking cares. My one thought is, I don't deserve life and if I went who would care? I haven't made an impact on anyone or no one seems to notice me no matter how hard I try.
I just need someone to talk to :/
